requirements.summary: Public GET liveness returns 200 promptly and is not cached.
Public GET readiness checks required persistence and storage dependencies and returns 200 or 503.
API errors expose a stable code plus a human-readable message after adapter normalization.
Session cookies are HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, scoped narrowly, and Secure on HTTPS.
Unsafe cookie-authenticated requests require a session-bound CSRF value.
Browser responses prevent MIME sniffing and framing and declare referrer/resource policy.
Request body bytes and receive time are bounded before business handlers.
Access and error logs redact credentials, cookies, CSRF values, and bearer tokens.
